create.title: Start a task in a worktree
create.body: Open New Session and pick Worktree. Name it with a few words or an issue like #123, choose a base under From, then click Create.
create.hint: Create a worktree session to continue

card.title: A checkout of its own
card.body: The new session sits in its own checkout block, with its branch on the header. Its agent works there without touching your main checkout's files.

branch.title: The branch on screen
branch.body: This chip shows the branch of the session on screen. Click it for its history and branch actions.
